query: What signals suggest a goal will be highly achieved?

per_column.name: completion_gap
per_column.rationale: Gap between percent_complete and target_percentage is a direct arithmetic function of the achievement outcome; it essentially encodes whether the goal was met, so it leaks the focus rather than predicting it independently.

per_column.name: progress_ratio
per_column.rationale: A ratio of progress to target (percent_complete/target_percentage) is a deterministic transform of the completion state, which is the outcome itself. High ratio ≈ high achievement, so this is a restatement/leakage.

per_column.name: priority_score
per_column.rationale: Numeric encoding of priority is an ex-ante attribute lying outside the outcome and could plausibly correlate with achievement (e.g., high-priority goals get more resources). Legitimate predictor, though it mostly re-encodes the existing priority column so adds little new signal.

per_column.name: duration_days
per_column.rationale: Planned span between start_date and end_date is known ex-ante and independent of the outcome; goal timeframe can plausibly carry signal about achievement likelihood. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: is_on_track
per_column.rationale: Being 'on track' is a mid/late-flight status derived from progress vs. plan; it is essentially a proxy for the achievement outcome and only knowable as the goal unfolds, so it leaks the focus.

per_column.name: high_achievement_score
per_column.rationale: A score explicitly built around 'high achievement' is a direct restatement of the focus variable itself, not an external predictor.

judge.rationale: Four of six added columns (completion_gap, progress_ratio, is_on_track, high_achievement_score) are deterministic functions or proxies of the completion/achievement outcome and constitute leakage or restatement of the focus variable. Only priority_score and duration_days are legitimate ex-ante predictors, and both largely re-encode information already present in the original columns (priority, start_date/end_date), so they add little genuine incremental predictive leverage. As a set, the augmentation is dominated by leakage and offers weak independent signal.
